title: Kili Row
start: Talk to Kili in the City of Um's smithy.
prereq_other: Collect a set of necromancer robes from Sostratus

items.t: 2 regular ghostly ink for drawing glyphs, or having the required glyphs already drawn
7 basic ghostly ink for drawing glyphs, or having the required glyphs already drawn
4 light sources for rituals, or having them already set up

recommended.t: 11 more basic ghostly ink and bones for conducting a lesser communion ritual, if doing this instead of killing chickens and if not having already drawn the required glyphs
Necromancy weapons for killing chickens, if doing this instead of a lesser communion ritual

kills.t: Optional; 5 chickens (level 1, must be damaged with Necromancy)

rewards.t: Access to lesser, regular, and greater ensoul material rituals
Ability to upgrade Death Skull equipment and deathwarden robe armour to tier 20
Ability to learn further equipment upgrades from Kili
Ability to access Thalmund and Thalmund's Wares

steps.t: Talk to Kili by the anvils in north-eastern corner of the City of Um [Chat: Accept]
Go to the ritual site in the City of Um
Select the Lesser ensoul material (Kili Row) with the pedestal
Complete the ritual (requires Change I glyph which requires two inkwells of regular ghostly ink and one inkwell of basic ghostly ink to draw)
Withdraw the output of the ritual from the ritual chest on the ritual site
Go back to Kili to get a soul urn
Kill five chickens using Necromancy anywhere or perform a lesser communion ritual at the ritual site.
